question: On what basis does the speaker claim to know the determination of the Kaula teaching in the presence of the Lord of the Kaulas?
premises: The speaker addresses the Lord of the Kaulas directly.
Knowledge of the Kaula determination is not claimed by personal effort alone.
That knowledge is attributed to the grace of the Lord of the Kaulas.
inference: By the Lord of the Kaulas' grace, the speaker has come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching.
uncertainties: The mode of grace is not specified
plain_english: By your grace, O Lord of the Kaulas, I have come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching.
